answer: Quorum escrow: a new identity locks 25 credits that return only after ten honest epochs. A cheating identity burns its escrow, sending a ripple of slashing into its voucher's stake. Fakes pile like a gale against a dam: the nth fake costs 25 times n squared credits, 25, 100, 225, so ten fakes cost 9,625 credits. One honest river of work beats a flood of copies.
